subject.title: Isolated cron consistently fails with "LLM request failed" on model-call-started phase

question: Should #91363 stay open as the umbrella for the remaining isolated-cron failure bundle, or should maintainers close it in favor of narrower canonical items after selecting the watchdog and stream-stall owners?
rationale: The remaining evidence crosses multiple active subcases, and choosing whether to preserve this umbrella versus split/close it is a maintainer coordination decision rather than a single safe automated repair.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Keep #91363 open until the setup-watchdog and stream-stall canonical fixes are landed or explicitly rejected, then close with links to the resolved subitems.

options.title: Close To Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Close #91363 now as superseded by #93912/#93914 and #91892, accepting that the July 6 session-reset evidence may need a new issue.

options.title: Create Session-Reset Follow-Up
options.body: Keep #91363 open only long enough to file a focused consecutive-error/session-reset issue, then close it as split.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Keep #91363 open until the setup-watchdog and stream-stall canonical fixes are landed or explicitly rejected, then close with links to the resolved subitems.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is about cron timeout/recovery product boundaries across several existing issues, and this handle appears in the relevant cron/fallback feature history.
